d: Very ordinary room, and poorly provided. Giacinto, Strettonium, Berto with bundle of cards, indi Mascherone.
Decent room in the Attorney's house; Emilia with a sheet in her hand, then Doralice, indi Strettonio.

Very simple cabinet, where Giacinto is combing at the hand of the Hairdresser; Mask, who sits near him explaining several things on a paper, which is reading. A Sarto with magnificent dress in his hands etc. then Lauretta.
Choir of Servi, Mercadants, Jewellers, Young shop artists with fabrics, baskets of merchandise, with joys, buckles, rings, watches etc.
Room in the DA's house with three doors, one in the middle, and two side doors. Berto and Strettonio, and then Emilia.
Emilia sola, then Giacinto with then pompous Staffieri, Lacche, etc.
Doralice, sealing a letter, then Lauretta.
Trivial room with wardrobe, chairs etc. Strectonio solo.
Room supplied, choir of several workers.
Common atrium with four doors. Doralice, and Lauretta.
Lauretta, then Emilia, then Doralice indi Mascherone.
The so-called Strettonium, and Giacinto coming out of one of the doors on the side where Lauretta entered.
Magnificent room, etc...Coro di Convitati e di diverse Workers che partono singing.

View of the little square and canal with boats. Strettonio in picciola boat, with three Players ordinarily dressed, and with guitarrino. Then Giacinto, Emilia, Doralice, and Mask dressed as Adonis, Venus, Mars, and Vulcano in a pompous boat, with band of Sounders.
Lauret alone, then Giacinto, and Mask.
Room illuminated with series of rooms in prospect etc. Four play tables, to one of 'Maskone, that cuts, and the Players, that point; to the other different Players.
Lauretta, then Emilia, Doralice, and Berto in mask.
Berto dressed as a slave officer, followed by Soldiers. Choir, Giacinto, Doralice, Emilia, Strettonio.
Sala. Emilia, Giacinto, Doralice, and then Berto
